thread:
michelle: quick flag - customer reported billing spike after a reconnect where router sent the resume to a canary and we saw toolcall + confirmed chunk tokens. filing notes here.
owen: can you paste the minimal timeline?
michelle: short: client stream started -> prefetch cached on backend-A -> truncation/latency event -> client reconnects -> router routes to backend-B (canary) -> backend-B performs toolcall to reconstruct prefix -> billing shows both provisional toolcall and later confirmed chunks from backend-A.
tara: logs?
michelle: snippet: ```
2026-04-05T11:05:10Z router assign backend=A session=cli_77 prefetch=pf_7
2026-04-05T11:05:12Z backend-A emit seq=1 tokens=+36
2026-04-05T11:05:13Z truncation invoked policy=latency_guard
2026-04-05T11:05:14Z billing provisional session=cli_77 tokens=+150 prov_id=pref_pf_7
2026-04-05T11:05:15Z client reconnect hint=cli_77
2026-04-05T11:05:15Z router assign backend=B session=cli_77-resume
2026-04-05T11:05:15Z backend-B toolcall fetch prefix=pf_7 toolcall_id=tc_21 tokens=+145 prov_id=pref_pf_7
2026-04-05T11:05:16Z backend-A confirm ledger session=cli_77 tokens=+36
2026-04-05T11:05:17Z billing final session=cli_77 tokens=+181
```
tara: final 181 = 36 + 145. ledger didn't collapse by provenance.
owen: current dedupe keys are local provisional ids only, which differ when backend-B created the toolcall. two quick fixes: 1) have router pass prefetch ownership/hint so backend-B can ask backend-A to transfer instead of re-toolcalling; 2) annotate provisional grants with client_session_id + resume_seq so ledger can collapse duplicates.
michelle: agree. for safety we can also hold toolcall grants provisional longer (e.g., 5s) when a reconnect hint is detected to allow dedupe.
tara: UX: console should show per-session provisional spikes and a link to reconnect traces; also an alert that fires when provisional > X and final delta > Y within 1m.
ops-bot: alert: billing-anomaly customer=skyline-inc delta=+181 window=2m ticket=T-6123
own: action items: Tara to prototype ledger collapse by (session, prefetch_id) with resume_seq precedence; Michelle to add router resume_hint propagation and an ownership transfer RPC; I'll run a small canary and synthetic replay to validate.
tara: i'll build a tiny harness that simulates reconnects + router swap and add unit tests for confirm ordering.
michelle: i'll post the internal ticket and loop in support. closing for now. :thumbsup:
